subject: Assurance bundle transfer protocol for CloudScale marketplace listing
messages:
From: Sanjay Shah <sanjay@cloudscale.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@marketplace-pro.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security & compliance package for AWS listing

Marissa —

Thanks again for taking this through with CloudScale. AWS marketplace underwriting asked us to supply the full assurance bundle for co-sell enablement: SOC 2 Type II (redacted ok), a pen-test attestation/letter, and an executed DPA. Can you confirm:

- What you can provide by next Tuesday (2027-06-15)
- Whether the SOC2 will be a redacted PDF or a summary attestation
- Who at Redwood will be the single contact for DocuSign / signature coordination

We also need to understand if any extra artifacts are required for co-sell (AWS wants to see evidence of data residency controls for our account).

Appreciate a quick plan/update so we can keep the AWS listing window.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Shah
Head of Cloud Partnerships, CloudScale
[sanjay@cloudscale.io]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Shah <sanjay@cloudscale.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, Priya Rao <priya.rao@marketplace-pro.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security & compliance package for AWS listing

Sanjay —

Thanks — short plan below, aiming to deliver the full bundle by EOD Monday (2027-06-14) so you have time to upload before the marketplace review cutoff:

1) SOC 2 Type II (redacted PDF) — Kimberly will prepare a redacted copy that removes customer-specific identifiers and sensitive findings, but includes scope and auditor opinion.
2) Pen test letter — we have a recent vendor attestation; Kimberly will include the 1-page letter and a summary of remediation items.
3) DPA — Rishi will circulate the redline and a DocuSign envelope for signature. We will request CloudScale to sign via DocuSign to keep an audit trail.
4) Data residency note — Jordan will attach a short note confirming regions where customer data may be stored and egress controls.

Attachments: assurance-checklist-20270610.xlsx (internal tracker).

Kimberly / Rishi / Jordan — can each confirm ownership and add estimated drop times (with attachments)? I will be the single point for uploading to AWS / Azure / GCP listing portals.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sanjay Shah <sanjay@cloudscale.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, Priya Rao <priya.rao@marketplace-pro.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security & compliance package for AWS listing

Marissa / Sanjay —

Confirmed. I'll produce the redacted SOC2 and the pen-test letter: estimated drop time Monday 2027-06-14 by 10:00 PT. Notes on redaction policy:

- We redact customer names, IP addresses of customer workloads, and any vulnerability details tied to customer data.
- Auditor opinion, control descriptions, test procedures, and the date range remain intact (this meets AWS marketplace expectations in prior listings).

Attachment placeholders (to be attached Monday):
- SOC2_redacted_2027-06.pdf (PDF, redacted)
- penetration-letter-2027.pdf (PDF, 1 page attestation)

If CloudScale needs an unredacted SOC under an NDA, let us know and Rishi and I will coordinate a controlled exchange.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Assurance Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
[Attachment: SOC2_redacted_2027-06.pdf (to be provided)]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sanjay Shah <sanjay@cloudscale.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, Priya Rao <priya.rao@marketplace-pro.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security & compliance package for AWS listing

Team / Sanjay —

I've attached the DPA redline (DPA_redline_CloudScale.docx) and created a DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/en/envelope/ABCDEF-20270611. Expected steps:

1) CloudScale reviews redline and returns comments (if any) by EOD Tuesday 2027-06-15.
2) If only signature is required, we'll drop the final DPA into DocuSign and route to CloudScale.
3) If substantive terms are requested, allow up to 3 business days for finalization.

On data residency: our standard config for this account will pin compute to us-west-2 and storage to us-west-2 for the AWS co-sell SKU. We'll produce a short note (Jordan) confirming that and outlining egress controls.

Attachment: DPA_redline_CloudScale.docx

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Sanjay Shah <sanjay@cloudscale.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, Priya Rao <priya.rao@marketplace-pro.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security & compliance package for AWS listing

Marissa / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and clear owners. We will:

- Review the SOC2_redacted_2027-06.pdf and penetration-letter-2027.pdf when you drop them Monday morning.
- Have our legal review your DPA_redline_CloudScale.docx; if everything looks standard we'll sign in DocuSign.
- Confirm co-sell entitlements (we need a brief note from Redwood on what co-sell support level is expected post-listing).

If you can upload the bundle to the AWS partner console or provide a single zipped packet (and a HubSpot linked record), that will expedite underwriting.

Thanks — aiming to close listing by Wednesday.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Shah
Head of Cloud Partnerships, CloudScale
[sanjay@cloudscale.io]
